name: AUSA Student Care financial counselling
summary: Free, confidential financial counselling for Adelaide University students dealing with debt, rent, bills or budgeting.
how: Email ausa.financialcounselling@adelaide.edu.au to book in person, online or by phone
catches: The financial counsellor can also help you access AUSA loans and grants for financial hardship

evidence.quote: free, confidential, and non-judgmental program that is available to all Adelaide University students.
Student Care administers a range of loans and grants to assist students in financial hardship.
